name: iasig
description: Compare Moldovan insurance and vignette offers for your saved vehicles, people and home (RCA, Green Card, roadside assistance, vignettes, travel and home insurance), then continue to iasig.md to review and pay.

interface.longDescription:
iAsig is a Moldovan insurance platform. Connect your iAsig account to compare offers from licensed Moldovan insurers and buy vignettes without leaving the chat.

What you can do:
- RCA (mandatory motor third-party liability) for vehicles registered in Moldova, and RCA for vehicles registered abroad.
- Green Card for Europe or Ukraine, from 15 days to one year.
- Roadside assistance in Romania and the EU (15 days, 1 year, or 1 year with a replacement car).
- Vignettes: the Romanian rovinieta, EU vignettes (Austria, Hungary, Czechia, Slovakia, Bulgaria, Switzerland and more) and the Moldovan vignette for vehicles registered abroad.
- Travel medical insurance for single trips or multi-trip contracts.
- Sigur Acasă home insurance for your saved apartment or house.
- The yearly Moldovan road tax amount, with a link to pay it on MPay.
- Several products for one trip (for example a Green Card, a rovinieta and EU vignettes) in one order with one payment.
- Use the vehicles, people and properties already saved in your iAsig account, so you do not retype registration certificate or ID numbers.
- When you pick an offer, get a link to continue on iasig.md. There the order is prepared in your own iAsig account, you review it and you pay. Nothing is bought or charged in ChatGPT.
- Check the status of your iAsig orders.

Privacy: the assistant only sees masked data (for example the last digits of a plate or ID number). It never sees or asks for card details. You can disconnect ChatGPT at any time at mcp.iasig.md/connections.

Other iAsig products (CASCO and more) are available on iasig.md.

defaultPrompt: How much is a Green Card for Europe for 15 days for my car?
I'm driving to Austria through Romania next month. What do I need for my car?
How much is roadside assistance in Europe for a year?

positive.prompt: What insurance can you help me with?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the products that can be quoted in the chat (RCA, RCA for vehicles registered abroad, Green Card, roadside assistance, EU, Romanian and Moldovan vignettes, travel and home insurance, and the road tax amount) and links to iasig.md for the others, such as CASCO.

positive.prompt: How much is a Green Card for Europe for 15 days for my BMW X5?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Green Card offers from several Moldovan insurers with prices in MDL, the earliest start date and how long the quote is valid. Nothing is created or charged.

positive.prompt: How much is roadside assistance in Europe for one year for my Renault Fluence?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the roadside assistance packages (15 days, 1 year, 1 year Plus with a replacement car) with prices in MDL and the allowed start dates.

positive.description: Vignette for a vehicle registered abroad
positive.prompt: My Skoda Octavia registered in Ukraine needs a Moldovan vignette for 30 days. How much is it?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Moldovan vignette periods for that vehicle with prices in MDL, including the 30 days period.

positive.prompt: How much is home insurance for my saved apartment?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Sigur Acasă packages for the saved property with prices and cover limits in MDL, and the earliest start date (7 days ahead).

positive.description: Continue on iasig.md with a chosen offer
positive.prompt: I'll take the cheapest Green Card offer for the BMW X5 starting tomorrow. Give me the link to finish on iasig.md.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the insurer, price, start date, vehicle, insured person and where the policy will be sent, asks the user to confirm, then returns a link to mcp.iasig.md. Opening the link and clicking Continue prepares an unpaid order on iasig.md, where the user can review and pay. Nothing is charged in ChatGPT and the assistant does not open the link.

positive.description: Romanian vignette asks for the Euro class
positive.prompt: How much is a Romanian vignette for 10 days for my Tesla Model Y?
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes the rovinieta periods with prices in MDL and RON. For a vehicle whose price depends on its Euro emission class, the assistant asks the user for the class instead of guessing it (an electric vehicle gets its own class automatically).

review.commerce_description: Users compare Moldovan insurance offers (RCA, Green Card, roadside assistance, travel medical and home insurance) and road vignettes in ChatGPT. These are real-world purchases used outside ChatGPT (on the road, at borders, during a trip or for a home), not digital products, subscriptions, digital content, tokens or credits; app stores treat them the same way (Apple App Store Review Guideline 3.1.3(e) goods and services consumed outside the app, and 3.2.1(v) insurance apps cannot use in-app purchase). Checkout is external, on our own domain: when the user chooses an offer, the plugin returns a link to iasig.md. Only after the user opens that link and clicks Continue is an unpaid order prepared in their iAsig account, and they review and pay on iasig.md (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay or MIA). No order, purchase or payment happens inside ChatGPT, and the plugin never asks for card details.

publication.release_notes: New products: RCA for vehicles registered abroad, roadside assistance in Romania and the EU, the Romanian rovinieta, EU vignettes, the Moldovan vignette for vehicles registered abroad, travel medical insurance, Sigur Acasă home insurance (with your saved properties) and the road tax amount. Several products for one trip can now go in one order with one payment. As before, you continue to iasig.md to review and pay.
